newsitem.title: USA: Comsat chairman Silas resigns, Colodny named.
newsitem.headline: Comsat chairman Silas resigns, Colodny named.

text.p: Comsat Corp said Wednesday its chairman, C.J. Silas, has resigned from that position and as a member of the board for health reasons, following recent open-heart surgery.
The company, a global provider of communications services and products, said its board has elected Edwin Colodny, who has been a director since 1992, as chairman.
Colodny was former chairman and chief executive of US Airways Group Inc and its unit, US Airways Inc, formerly USAir, and is a director of both corporations.
He is also a director of Ascent Entertainment Group Inc and Esterline Technologies Corp and a member of the board of trustees of the University of Rochester.
